name: Duet Date Picker
description: Integrates the accessible Duet Date Picker web component as Drupal field widgets (datetime and daterange) and Views date filters.
library_dependencies: npm-asset/duetds--date-picker (Duet Date Picker web component, >= 1.4; installed locally at /libraries/duetds--date-picker)
project_description: Duet Date Picker integrates the framework-agnostic, accessibility-focused Duet Date Picker web component (duetds/date-picker) into Drupal. It ships two field widgets that replace core's date input on datetime and daterange fields, three Views filter handlers (date, datetime, and Search API date) that add an optional Duet picker to exposed date filters, and a NoPastDates validation constraint. The picker component itself is loaded from a locally-installed asset library. The installed release is a pre-release beta (1.0.0-beta5).
